title: Enterprise Application Management Governance & Operating Model (Microsoft Endpoint / Intune)
author_notes: pricing: T4 — multi-workstream org-wide operating model (governance layer spanning ownership/RACI, intake, review board, standards, risk-tiered change + CAB interface, tiered support, and security-stack integration; higher effort and org-wide scope than a single-platform Intune config solution).

gov decision: gov_variant=false. The governance process, roles, decision rights, and artefacts are identical for Commercial and Government tenants; the only difference is portal/Graph URLs (endpoint.microsoft.us, portal.azure.us, login.microsoftonline.us, graph.microsoft.us). All scripts accept -GraphEnvironment USGov and the docs carry a Government URL note. No distinct Gov deliverable required; where a specific Intune feature's GCC High/DoD availability is uncertain the docs say 'verify for GCC High'.

SCOPE: governance/operating-model ANCHOR product only. Deliberately does NOT re-teach packaging (WIN32), third-party patching (TPP), or install troubleshooting (INTAPPDX) — it describes HOW governance plugs into Intune/WDAC/MDE/App Protection, not their configuration.
